name: GWM
note: Rating note: GWM is the global marque of Great Wall Motor Company Limited, a listed company (HKEX 2333 / SSE 601633) ultimately controlled by chairman Wei Jianjun through Baoding Innovation Great Wall Asset Management (59.78%). No state shareholding appears in the annual report's shareholder sections. The December 2022 Sheffield Hallam 'Driving Force' report on Uyghur forced labour in automotive supply chains was checked and does not name Great Wall Motor/GWM/Haval specifically; no other human-rights finding against the company was found. Propose 'none'.
